title: Migrate raw SQL queries to the query builder

events.content: Migrate the raw SQL in db/queries/invoices.py to the query builder without changing the returned columns.
I converted list_invoices and get_invoice. The totals query still uses a window function that the builder cannot express.
Do the same for db/queries/customers.py, and keep the pagination behaviour identical.
customers.py is converted. Open items: port the invoice totals window function, and run the pagination snapshot tests.
